summary: Iteration 37 — Voice Note Transcript (Whisper caption). Backend: `python -m pytest tests/test_family_voice.py -q -p no:warnings -n 0` → 5 passed in 24.01s, including the real TTS→Whisper round-trip (TestVoiceCaption.test_caption_is_produced_asynchronously_from_real_speech) and the unreadable-audio→unavailable test. XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter37.xml. Frontend E2E on web preview (390x844, two Chromium contexts, microphone granted): Context A (Mum) onboarded (onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button) → /family → family-owner-name 'Mum' → family-make-code → family-pair-code text '427UMQ'. Context B (Sarah) onboarded → /family → owner 'Sarah' → family-link-code + family-link-button → linked (page body contains 'Mum'). Mum → /check with https://phishing.apollo.test/login → check-submit-button → apollo.patrol.events[0].scent_id captured → /patrol/scent/<id> → incident-share-family → incident-shared-note visible. Sarah → /family/incident/<scent> → voice-note-record → voice-note-stop (~3.5 s recording) → voice-note-send. family-note-caption-0 transitioned from 'Caption coming…' to ready within ~15 s with a nonsense caption “A short, warm voice message from a family member.” (fake-mic WebM). Mum reloaded /patrol/scent/<id>: incident-family-note-caption-0 showed the same nonsense caption within polling window. REAL-CAPTION path executed via Sarah's bearer using page_b.context.request (avoids Cloudflare 1010 on scripted UA): POST /api/voice/speak {device_id,text:'Hello Mum, it's Sarah, everything is fine'} → 200 (url,chars); GET the mp3 → 200, 41856 bytes; POST /api/family/incidents/<scent>/voice multipart (device_id, from_name=Sarah, duration_s=5, file=note.mp3 audio/mpeg) → 201, transcript_status=pending. Reloaded Mum /patrol/scent/<id>: incident-family-note-caption-1 flipped from 'Caption coming…' to “Hello mum, it's Sarah. Everything is fine.” within ~20 s (well under 30 s); assertion 'sarah' AND 'fine' both TRUE. Auto-polling behaviour verified: family/incident refetches every 5 s while any note is pending (family/incident/[id].tsx L66) and patrol/scent every 15 s (patrol/scent/[id].tsx L59). One UX observation reported below: Whisper on silence/short WebM sometimes echoes back the server-side prompt text ('A short, warm voice message from a family member.') — spec accepts this as 'nonsense caption' but it exposes internal prompt copy to end users.
action_items: OPTIONAL/UX: backend/services/transcribe.py L25 passes prompt='A short, warm voice message from a family member.' to Whisper. On silent or very-short WebM (the exact case the web recorder produces from the headless fake tone), Whisper echoes the prompt verbatim as the transcript, and that string appears to end users as an italic 'quoted' caption on the incident. Consider (a) removing the prompt entirely (accept slightly lower quality on real speech), or (b) if the transcript equals/contains the prompt string (case-insensitive), coerce transcript_status to 'unavailable' before writing. This is not spec-blocking (the spec explicitly permits 'nonsense caption'), but it currently surfaces internal prompt copy to end users.
critical_code_review_comments: transcribe.py L15-42: caption pipeline is correctly non-blocking — note is saved and returned with transcript_status=pending, caption_voice_note runs as a background task and writes ready|unavailable. Timeout 40 s is a good safety net.

VoiceCaption (VoiceNote.tsx L128-134) renders exactly three UI states as specified: pending → 'Caption coming…', ready+text → italic quoted string, unavailable → 'No caption for this one — press play to listen.'. testID plumbed through correctly.

family/incident/[id].tsx L66: refetchInterval is a function of note-status → 5 s while any transcript_status==='pending', otherwise off. Correct; matches spec ('screen auto-polls every 5 s while pending').

patrol/scent/[id].tsx L59: notes query polls every 15 s while shared; matches spec. However this poll is unconditional (not gated on pending), so it also refreshes when nothing is pending — harmless but slightly wasteful.

Both screens key notes by index (family-note-caption-{i}, incident-family-note-caption-{i}); safe as long as backend returns notes in stable creation order (verified: cap-0 = first webm note, cap-1 = second mp3 note).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Sarah cap-0 flips ready with nonsense caption; Mum cap-0 mirrors; Mum cap-1 from real TTS mp3 contains 'sarah' and 'fine' within ~20 s)

seed_data_creation: One paired device pair (Mum↔Sarah) and one shared incident with two voice notes (1 webm + 1 mp3) were created on the shared preview backend during E2E. Non-blocking for prod-shaped preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two-context Chromium E2E is required (page + page.context.browser.new_context). Playwright is `page.context` PROPERTY not method. Grant microphone via ctx.grant_permissions(['microphone'], origin=BASE) for both contexts. localStorage identity key is `apollo.device.identity.v2` and is DOUBLE-JSON-ENCODED (json.loads twice) with fields `deviceId`, `token`, `expiresAt`. `apollo.patrol.events` is also double-encoded. testIDs used: onboarding-start-button, disclosure-accept-button, family-owner-name, family-make-code, family-pair-code (contains the 6-char code, spaces need stripping), family-link-code, family-link-button, check-url-input, check-submit-button, incident-share-family, incident-shared-note, incident-family-note-caption-{i}, voice-note-record, voice-note-stop, voice-note-send, family-note-caption-{i}. For scripted API calls against the preview URL, use page.context.request (Playwright request context inherits browser TLS fingerprint) — bare urllib/requests with UA 'apollo-tests' get Cloudflare error 1010 on some paths (e.g., GET /api/voice/{key}.mp3).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs identified. Whisper-prompt-echo is a UX smell, not a bug; spec explicitly permits nonsense captions. Suggested mitigation captured in action_items.
